Subject: Decision requested: Six-week invoice-handling pilot

Hi Morgan,

I recommend moving forward with the approved six-week pilot to assess invoice handling. The fixed fee is $30,000, and production rollout is excluded.

Your team’s hope is to reduce handling time by 20%. Because no baseline or measured savings exists, the pilot can assess progress toward that target without treating it as a guaranteed result.

The next decision is whether you approve the pilot scope and fee, subject to security clearance. Security approval is required before access to client data. No start date has been approved.

Please confirm whether you approve the scope and fee subject to security clearance.

Best,  
Jordan  
Engagement Lead
